subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the segment with the grammatical error.

Jawed refused politely / a second serving of the custard by / the host at / Hotel Grand yesterday.

options.text: a second serving of the custard by

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence has a grammatical error in the phrase "**a second serving of the custard by**."
 
• The preposition "**by**" is incorrectly used in this context. It should be replaced with "**from**" to indicate who is offering the custard.
 
• The corrected phrase should be "**a second serving of the custard from**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Jawed refused politely a second serving of the custard from the host at Hotel Grand yesterday."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Jawed refused politely"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "Hotel Grand yesterday"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "the host at"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
